scope: One consolidated affected test pass and complete recomputation of the original five failed windows under the named policy. Reuse the twelve already-completed strict source results audited in26; do not repeat their source scans. No seventeen-way throughput, family-statistics or full-project runtime claim.

source_clock_contract.clock_claim: Named BBO-stream alternative only. No reconstructed receipt clock, snapshot generation time or exchange chronology.
source_clock_contract.continuation: Original terminal row and source identity remain separate from non-replay chronological highwater; original policy/adjacency state is bound into source and measurement carry and quote replay.
source_clock_contract.economic_state: No book recovery, fresh quote, OFI, trade, dwell or economic quote age reset from disposed records. Preserve blocked/trust state. Count replay raw occupancy in its original native bin so it cannot create falsely quiet eligible coverage.
source_clock_contract.qualification: Backward A/N/168 only after physically adjacent original A/M/C/128 from the same physical source and instrument with exact equal valid finite positive quarter-point noncrossed BBO and positive sizes below uint32 sentinel. No prior T, changed BBO, invented adjacency, consecutive snapshot exemption or ordinary backward clock accepted.
source_clock_contract.raw_preservation: Keep every original field/timestamp/address/order/hash and all raw and snapshot counters. Only a proven BBO-redundant snapshot is absent from the economic quote and temporal-raw view; this is not an order-level duplicate claim.
